rationale: Exercise the active Candidate with actual three-node bootstrap, election, replication and configuration application. All protocol mutations use public RawNode methods. MemoryStorage represents crash-free durable writes; no crashes occur. Only TimeoutNow messages are dropped during the initial ten ticks; subsequent traffic and ticks are delivered and Ready work is drained. RawNode starts no goroutines, so no shutdown method is needed. Private state reads diagnose pending work without altering behavior.
question: Can a fully replicated implicit configuration overlap a public TransferLeader call before Advance, and does a finite TimeoutNow loss followed by reliable heartbeat/application draining leave the old joint configuration active after transfer timeout? Compare no-transfer control and later ordinary-proposal rescue; finite non-completion alone is not a progress violation.
